prior_hypothesis.hypothesis: The retained normal-reference attention is nearly uniform on training patients (normalized entropy.985-.994); replacing all9regions by their image mean hardly changes decisions. Spatial-consistency losses around the original pooling were ineffective. Test an explicit centered spatial-contrast residual pathway with D4 symmetry pooling, compared with matched parameter-capacity means. Diagnostic does not establish held-patient predictive value. Existing group-invariant MLP principles; no global novelty or clinical lesion-localization claim.
prior_hypothesis.geometry: Unchanged fit-only standardization and equal normal-patient PCA32fourstreams. All16arm/phasegeometrycopies and16patientplans frozen before fitting;4uniquephaseestimates. No spatial ridge/bank or external patients.
prior_hypothesis.architecture: Same original normal-reference attentionMLP. From GELU(original region projection128), subtract within-image9tokenmean, LayerNorm128, Linear128->r GELU. D4 arm applies all8rotations/reflections of3x3grid, flatten9r, shared Linear9r->r GELU, average8views. Capacitymatched mean arm repeats mean of9projectedtokenvalues9times, same Linear9r->r GELU once. Both Linear r->256 zeroinitializedreadout and.1residual before originalhiddenDropout. Rank16/32 gives4arms48heads. No extra loss/dropout/randomdraws. Originalinit/task/weights/hparams retained. Each also fixed.75branch/.25M5fusion gives8scores.
prior_hypothesis.selection: HighestoriginalCVcandidate strictly>M6 withVal>=M6 frozen before two unused3foldpatientrepeat confirmations vsM6/M5/fixedGaussian. Require highermean6foldF1 and pairedpatientbootstrap95%lowerbound>0 against each. Scan actual protocols for repeat freshness. No automatic external tests.

Initialidentity/basegradients/RNGexact,matchedcapacity,mean arbitrarypermutationinvariance,D4symmetry,andnonD4sensitivity tested. Updates/restores/frozenbuffers,actualCUDAfirstfulltaskwitness. Formalall48heads/stats/maps/epochs/normalbuffers/permutations/stopouterprobabilities/fulltaskwitnesses and16fusionphases independently restored;trainedD4symmetry andnonzeroreadout checked.
